measurement.purpose: Check available startup workloads for behavioral changes and measure timing without extrapolating to gameplay
measurement.scenario: Serial 10-second fresh-start runs per app in before/after/after/before order; no input; each sample has a fresh sandbox and IPA import. Hard stop captures live output, no graceful teardown. No concurrent cloud build/test during samples.
measurement.durationType: Host wall time, not guest simulation time
measurement.fixtures: Only three grandfathered SHA-256-verified main fixtures; exact hashes and versions in every sample
measurement.driverSource:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,platform,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path('.').resolve()/'tools'))
from compat_harness.runner import _run_one
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
manifest=json.load(open('tools/compat_harness/manifests/apps.json'))
rows=[]
for spec in manifest['apps']:
    if 'legacyRepoPath' not in spec:continue
    path=root/spec['legacyRepoPath']
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==spec['sha256']
    item=dict(id=spec['id'],sha256=spec['sha256'],status='resolved',path=str(path),displayPath=path.name,source='legacy-repo')
    for i,variant in enumerate(['before','after','after','before']):
        hvm=root/('build/before/hvm' if variant=='before' else 'build/hvm')
        out=root/'build'/'startup-abba'/str(i)
        a=_run_one(str(hvm),spec,item,str(out),10)
        a.update(variant=variant,iteration=i)
        shot=out/'work'/spec['id']/'frame.png'
        a['screenshotSha256']=hashlib.sha256(shot.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if shot.exists() else None
        rows.append(a)
        json.dump(rows,open('build/startup-samples.json','w'),indent=2)
        print(spec['id'],variant,i,a['launchSuccess'],a['perf'].get('avgFrameMs'),a['frame'].get('signal'),a['audio'].get('signal'),flush=True)
measurement.conclusion: Timing moves both directions; no performance improvement or sustained gameplay FPS gain established. All launches succeed, all final frame signals varied; Tiny Tower mixer stays active, others silent, with no dropped blocks or transport errors. Tiny Tower and Art of Glow screenshots match exactly across variants; Angry Birds frame hashes differ as startup advances.
